reports.note: NCSC says it received reports. The public post has no victim telemetry and no indicators.

agent.note: NCSC says an AI agent assisted and does not name it. ARTEX and CyberStrikeAI are named only in a count of internet-accessible agents. This profile is not evidence either one ran in these cases.

exploit.note: The agents used standard or easily guessed passwords and known vulnerabilities on internet-connected systems. NCSC does not name the vulnerabilities.

adapt.note: NCSC says the agents switch to other known methods when defenses react. The post does not name the second method.

owned.note: NCSC says every such attack it knows of ended in compromise of the victim's IT systems. It does not describe encryption, data theft, or downtime.
